910.name: Pre-Columbian Costa Rica
910.description: Early habitation, Diquís and Nicoya cultures, jade-working, gold-working, and the enigmatic stone spheres.

sub_clusters.name: Early Human Habitation
sub_clusters.description: Paleo-Indian to Archaic period, hunter-gatherers transitioning to horticulture in the Central Valley.

sub_clusters.name: Diquís Stone Spheres and Chiefdoms
sub_clusters.description: Mysterious granite spheres (UNESCO), Diquís Delta chiefdoms, gold-working, complex society.

sub_clusters.name: Nicoya and Jade Culture
sub_clusters.description: Mesoamerican-influenced Pacific coast, jade pendants, polychrome pottery, trade links to Mexico.

920.name: Intermediate Area Chiefdoms
920.description: Complex chiefdoms bridging Mesoamerican and South American culture zones, gold-working traditions.

sub_clusters.name: Guayabo Monumental Site
sub_clusters.description: Largest archaeological site in Costa Rica: stone causeways, aqueducts, mounds in Turrialba Valley.

sub_clusters.name: Gold-Working Traditions
sub_clusters.description: Intricate gold figurines and ornaments, trade with Chiriquí (Panama) and Colombian cultures.

sub_clusters.name: Huetar and Chorotega Peoples
sub_clusters.description: Major ethnic groups at Spanish contact: Huetar in the Central Valley, Chorotega in Nicoya.

930.name: Spanish Colonisation of Costa Rica
930.description: Columbus's 1502 landfall, slow colonisation, small-farmer colonial society, marginal status in the Captaincy General.

sub_clusters.name: Columbus's Fourth Voyage Contact
sub_clusters.description: Columbus reaches Limón coast, names it 'Costa Rica' (Rich Coast) for indigenous gold ornaments.

sub_clusters.name: Founding of Cartago and Colonial Life
sub_clusters.description: Cartago founded as colonial capital, small population, subsistence farming, relative poverty.

sub_clusters.name: Marginal Colony within Guatemala Captaincy
sub_clusters.description: Low Indigenous population, few encomiendas, yeoman farmer society, 'rural democracy' origins.

940.name: Independence and the Coffee Republic
940.description: Peaceful independence, brief union with Mexico and UPCA, rise of the coffee oligarchy.

sub_clusters.name: Independence and Federation Era
sub_clusters.description: Independence from Spain (1821), Mexican Empire annexation, United Provinces of Central America, separation.

sub_clusters.name: Coffee Boom and Liberal State
sub_clusters.description: Coffee transforms economy, cafetalero elite, export to Britain, railroad to Limón, national identity.

sub_clusters.name: National Campaign against William Walker
sub_clusters.description: Costa Rica joins fight against Walker's filibuster regime in Nicaragua, Battle of Santa Rosa, Juan Santamaría heroism.

950.name: Banana Republic and Social Reform
950.description: United Fruit Company influence, Atlantic railroad, labour movements, social guarantees.

sub_clusters.name: United Fruit and Banana Economy
sub_clusters.description: Minor Keith's railroad-for-land deal, United Fruit dominance, Afro-Caribbean workers, Limón province.

sub_clusters.name: Calderón's Social Reforms
sub_clusters.description: Social guarantees, labour code, University of Costa Rica, Costa Rican Social Security (CCSS).

950.name: 1948 Civil War and Abolition of the Military
950.description: Disputed election, Figueres's National Liberation Army, 44-day civil war, new constitution, army abolished.

sub_clusters.name: Figueres and the 1948 Revolution
sub_clusters.description: José Figueres leads armed uprising, defeats government forces, 2,000 killed.

sub_clusters.name: 1949 Constitution and Military Abolition
sub_clusters.description: New constitution abolishes standing army, creates Electoral Tribunal, women's suffrage, social democratic state.

sub_clusters.name: Second Republic Foundations
sub_clusters.description: PLN dominance, nationalised banking, welfare state expansion, Cold War neutrality.

960.name: Arias Peace Plan and Nobel Prize
960.description: Óscar Arias's Esquipulas peace plan for Central American conflicts, 1987 Nobel Peace Prize.

sub_clusters.name: Esquipulas II Peace Plan
sub_clusters.description: Regional peace accord to end Central American civil wars, framework for Nicaraguan and Salvadoran negotiations.

sub_clusters.name: Tradition of Neutrality
sub_clusters.description: Monge's proclamation of neutrality (1983), Costa Rica as peace broker amid regional conflicts.

960.name: Contemporary Costa Rica
960.description: Ecotourism model, renewable energy leader, institutional stability, inequality challenges, digital economy.

sub_clusters.name: Ecotourism and Environmental Leadership
sub_clusters.description: 25% of territory protected, ecotourism economy, reforestation success, 99% renewable electricity.

sub_clusters.name: Democratic Stability and Social Progress
sub_clusters.description: Peaceful transitions, same-sex marriage (2020), high Human Development Index, education investment.

sub_clusters.name: Contemporary Challenges
sub_clusters.description: Fiscal deficit, Nicaraguan immigration, COVID-19 impact, cybersecurity attacks (2022), inequality.

unassigned_events.note: Events not yet assigned to a thematic cluster
